english.title: Begin to install gauge to measure or record flow, level or volume inland waters within 3 months of notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having proposed to install a gauge for measuring and recording the flow, level or volume of inland waters other than discrete waters, began the work of installing it before **(..SPECIFY DATE BEFORE WHICH WORK SHOULD NOT TAKE PLACE..), that date being the end of the period of three months beginning with the date of service of notice or shorter period allowed by the appropriate agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 200(1)(b) and (4) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
